title.narrative: COVID-19 INVESTMENT RESPONSE - EU4BUSINESS RECOVERY

description.narrative: The Action will contribute to BiHs efforts in mitigating the negative economic effects of COVID-19 crisis. Specifically, the Action will support MSMEs, agri-food and tourism operators and farmers ensuring the business continuity while also stimulating creation of innovative start-ups as a response to the COVID-19 crisis. As a result, at least 150 businesses should re-launch activities, over 1,000 jobs will be retained and at least 100 innovative start-ups will be created. Ultimately, the assisted companies should become more resilient by adapting more sustainable business models, diversifying product portfolios and markets while maintaining the current workforce and gradually creating new jobs.

Furthermore at the time of Action design MSMEs in BH and globally faced closures inability to export reduced workforce thus affecting the forecast for the indicator. During this time a number of layoffs were forecasted since the companies were not able to operate under the given circumstances. This led to a very pessimistic estimate of the number of jobs retained as it was almost impossible to predict the duration and the severity of COVID19 impact on local economy. In addition the postCOVID19 recovery was much quicker and robust than anticipated making BIH economy growth outperform its most optimistic forecasts GDP growth in 2021 was at 7.5.Although Action planned to support 150 MSMEs in five sectors in the Tourism sector alone the number of beneficiaries supported amounted to 146 MSMEs 20 planned. Total number of supported beneficiaries sums up to 392 MSMEs in all five sectors. That is why the Baseline data amounted to much higher number than forecasted target value.At the end of implementation supported MSMEs have reported that they employed 9.504 employees on average in the last 12 months or within the implementation period if shorter than 12 months. The IPs provided very targeted support to the MSMEs focusing on building resilience and recovery. This includes specific technical assistance alongside the financial support.For all the reasons mentioned above the number of decent jobs retained sustained through the Action was reported significantly higher than forecasted.
